user_prompt: We need a way to automatically flag outdated information in our internal wiki when referenced policies or procedures are updated in our source systems—right now our procurement team keeps making decisions based on old vendor qualification standards because the wiki doesn't sync with our master policy database.

steps.step_name: Set up automatic synchronization to flag outdated information in our internal wiki when referenced policies or procedures are updated in our source systems
Implement a real-time data sync mechanism between our master policy database and the wiki to ensure procurement team decisions are based on current vendor qualification standards

intent_resolver.reason: The request is a systems integration and data governance problem (wiki sync with policy database), not an end-to-end operational process that any registered skill covers.
